title: coptosperma neurophyllum
intro: Coptosperma neurophyllum, commonly known as the Golden Birdsnest, is a plant species native to tropical Africa. The Golden Birdsnest has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Coptosperma neurophyllum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
